jobs.title: Geospatial and Digital Innovation Development Leader
jobs.description:
Matrix New World Engineering, a part of True Environmental and its partner firms, have united their strengths to establish the nation's premier environmental and engineering services consulting firm. This powerhouse organization offers an extensive range of services aimed at revolutionizing the built environment and preserving the natural one. Its diverse expertise encompasses environmental remediation, urban planning, engineering iconic coastal and marine structures, developing sustainable energy sources, and pioneering resource extraction methods. Explore further at www.MWNE.com and True-Environmental.com to discover the full scope of our capabilities.

True Environmental is seeking a hands-on technical leader to drive geospatial, digital, and AI innovation into everything we do. Working directly with engineers, scientists, GIS staff, and project managers across our six practice groups (Natural Resources and Regulatory Services, Mining, Environmental, Engineering, Water Resources, and Federal) you will learn how each team delivers its work and build the tools, platforms, and workflows that make that work faster, more accurate, and more valuable to clients in the Transportation and Infrastructure, Water, Energy, Power and Utilities, Mining, Industrial, Environmental, and Natural Resources markets.

You will be the firm’s U.S.-based technical authority for enterprise GIS, geomatics, and digital solutions across all practices, and the person who turns emerging technology into everyday practice. You will design the geodatabases, write the scripts, build the applications, integrate the data feeds, and apply AI in a manner that improves how we compile data, detect change, and deliver results. Just as importantly, you will train project teams to use what you create, so innovation reaches every project. Alongside our technical leadership, you will represent the firm in front of clients and present at industry conferences, and you will coordinate with digital technology leaders in Canada to identify, develop, and leverage tools across True. The position reports to the Chief Operating Officer and works in a matrixed relationship with practice leads across the firm.

### **What You Will Do**

**Cross-Practice Technical Leadership**

* Act as the U.S. technical lead for geospatial and digital solutions, supporting all six practice groups: Natural Resources and Regulatory Services, Mining, Environmental, Engineering, Water Resources, and Federal.
* Partner with each practice to map current workflows, identify where spatial data and automation can remove manual effort or improve decision quality, and prioritize a development backlog.
* Establish firm-wide standards for geodatabase design, metadata, data governance, QA/QC, and deliverable formats so geospatial output is consistent regardless of practice or office.
* Coordinate with digital technology leaders in Canada to identify, develop, and leverage tools across True, aligning platforms and avoiding duplicated development.
* Serve as technical reviewer for geospatial deliverables and provide expert input on proposals when practices need a defined digital scope.

**Product and Platform Development**

* Design and build enterprise geodatabases, web-mapping applications, custom dashboards, and digital-twin platforms that integrate 2D/3D mapping, asset inventories, document repositories, point clouds, BIM/Revit models, and inspection and monitoring records.
* Develop repeatable analytical tools and workflows for recurring project needs, for example: cut/fill and dredging analysis, discharge and runout modeling, routing and constraint analysis, contaminant plume and exceedance visualization, impervious surface and flood-exposure analysis, and automated regulatory reporting (figures, tables, EDDs).
* Build and maintain field data collection applications (Survey123, Field Maps, Fulcrum, or custom) and the pipelines that move field data into enterprise databases and client deliverables.
* Integrate real-time and external data sources (IoT sensors, AIS, weather and environmental feeds, bathymetric and LiDAR scans) into living data products.
* Automate with Python, SQL, JavaScript, ModelBuilder, and FME; convert legacy CAD/MicroStation, Access, Excel, and PDF data into spatially enabled databases.

**Innovation and Technology Evaluation**

* Evaluate and pilot emerging capabilities, including GeoAI and LLM-assisted data compilation and metadata generation, automated defect and change detection from imagery and point clouds, open-source geospatial stacks, cloud deployment, and immersive/XR visualization, and establish practical, governed paths to adoption.
* Direct reality-capture programs in coordination with field teams: terrestrial and bathymetric LiDAR, sonar, UAS photogrammetry and inspection.
* Identify project-built tools that can be hardened into reusable firm assets or client-facing products.

**Client Representation, Enablement, and Training**

* Together with technical leadership, represent the firm in front of clients and present at industry conferences, user groups, and professional associations.
* Develop SOPs, written and video tutorials, and training programs so practice staff can use and maintain the tools you build.
* Mentor GIS analysts and developers across practices on development practices, database design, and scripting; you will influence and guide, not line-manage, these staff.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Geography, Geospatial Science, Environmental Science/Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship.
* 20+ years of progressive geospatial and application-development experience, with substantial time as technical lead on multidisciplinary projects in an environmental, engineering, AEC, or public-sector setting.
* GISP certification (or ability to obtain within 12 months).
* Deep expertise in the Esri platform: ArcGIS Pro,

jobs.title: Remote Sensing Project Manager
jobs.description:
Short Description:

Bowman has an opportunity for a Remote Sensing Project Manager to join our team Remotely, however, must be based in Austin, TX.

At Bowman, we believe in creating opportunities for aspiring people to thrive and achieve ambitious goals. That’s why a career at Bowman is more than a job. It is an opportunity to be part of a diverse and engaged community of professionals, to be treated as a respected and valued member of a motivated team and to be empowered to do exceptional work that advances the best interest of everyone involved. We recognize the importance of creating a work environment that is both rewarding to our employees and supportive of our unwavering commitment to provide unparalleled service to our clients.

Overview:

Oversee and manage LiDAR and UAS projects from initiation to completion. Identify new business opportunities, develop proposals, and build and maintenance client relations.

Responsibilities:

**Leadership and Direction**

* Receive broad guidance from senior-level management relating to overall key objectives, critical issues, new concepts, and policy matters and general parameters for execution. Manage people and processes to ensure effective execution. Review work produced by staff for quality assurance.

**At the Operational and Company Level**

* Assist with the marketing of the firm’s capabilities to establish new clients and enhance relationships.
* Serve as primary point of contact for clients, stakeholders, and team members to ensure that projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the client’s satisfaction.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities, develop proposals, and build and maintain client relationships.

**Do the Work**

* Oversee and manage LiDAR and UAS projects from initiation to completion.
* Develop and maintain project plans, including schedules, budgets, resource allocation, and risk assessments.
* Provide leadership and mentorship to project team members.
* Collaborate with internal and external teams to ensure project milestones are achieved.
* Ensure quality control standards are met and adhere to industry best practices.
* Train and mentor team members on LiDAR and UAS best practices and technologies.
* Stay up to date with UAS regulations, best practices, and emerging technologies.
* Collaborate with the marketing team to develop marketing materials and strategies.
* Participate in industry conferences or events as a guest speaker or panelist to share insights and expertise.
* Create and maintain a social media presence to showcase the company's LiDAR and UAS projects and engage with potential clients and collaborators.
* Lead internal company initiatives focused on sustainability or social responsibility, such as identifying opportunities to use LiDAR and UAS technologies for environmental monitoring or disaster relief efforts.
* Explore new and innovative applications for LiDAR and UAS technologies, such as using drones equipped with LiDAR sensors for wildlife tracking or mapping archaeological sites.

Success Metrics and Competencies:

* Ability to work both independently and within a team environment.
* Ability to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization and external partners.
* Highly motivated and problem-solving attitude.
* Strong sense of urgency in responding to constituents.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong work ethic and commitment to quality.
* Self-reliance and ability to operate independently with limited direction.
* Strong marketing/business development skills and mindset.
* Commitment to driving profitability and growth.
* Effective working relationship with internal leaders and peers, as well as external clients.
* Commitment to working in partnership with others inside and outside the organization.
* Focus on improving return on investment.
* Data analysis and interpretation skills.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's or master's degree in geomatics, surveying, engineering, or a related field.
* Eight or more (8+) years of work experience, preferably directly on LiDAR and UAS projects, with three or more (3+) years of project management experience, including technical oversight and business development.
* Strong understanding of LiDAR and UAS technologies, applications, and best practices.
* Experience with LiDAR data processing software, such as TerraSolid, LP360, or Global Mapper.
* Experience with project management software, such as Microsoft Project, Asana, or Trello.
* Knowledge of industry regulations and standards related to LiDAR and UAS projects.
* UAS pilot license or certification.
* Knowledge of remote sensing technologies and applications.
* Experience in business development and sales.
* Familiarity with the following processing software:
  + Inertial Explorer
  + TerraSolid
  + TopoDOT
  + Global Mapper
  + Pix4Dcapture
  + Context Capture
  + Bayes Strip Align
  + UgCS
  + Trimble Business Center
  + AutoCAD Civil 3D
  + Bentley MicroStation/ORD
  + AutoDesk ReCap
  + Cloud Compare
  + AutoDesk Revit
  + Trimble Stratus

Physical Demands and Working Environment:

* Primarily indoor professional office environment which may include bright/dim light, noise, fumes, odors, and traffic.
* Mobility around an office environment.
* Frequent and prolonged use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.
* Partly outdoor work environment which may include adverse weather conditions, varying temperatures, excessive noise, and/or potential hazards.
* Mobility around a job/construction site to include walking, bending, crawling, climbing, squatting, or kneeling and wearing of required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
* Primarily local travel during the business day, although some out-of-the-area and overnight travel may be required according to the needs of the business.
* Occasional lifting or carrying up to 20 pounds.
* Occasional pushing or pulling up to 20 pounds.
*

jobs.title: Research Environmental Scientist - Hydrometeorology
jobs.description:
Why RTI:

RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition. Our vision is to address the world's most critical problems with technical and science-based solutions in pursuit of a better future. Clients rely on us to answer questions that demand an objective and multidisciplinary approach—one that integrates expertise across social, statistical, data, and laboratory sciences, engineering, and other technical disciplines to solve the world’s most challenging problems.  
  
We believe in the promise of science and technical solutions, and we push ourselves every day to deliver on that promise for the good of people, communities, and businesses in the US and around the world. If you are looking for the opportunity to make a real difference, RTI is the place for you.

About the Hiring Group:

Are you passionate about water resources and environmental science? RTI’s Water, Agriculture, Natural Resources, and Energy Solutions (WARES) Group is seeking a motivated Research Environmental Scientist to join our hydromet and flood risk team. We develop innovative tools and analytical methods that support hydropower owners, dam safety programs, and the broader water resources community.

Our team is recognized for expertise in precipitation frequency analysis and probable flood hazard assessments (PFHA). As a nonprofit research institute, RTI also supports internal R&D to drive innovation and create real-world impact.

As part of the team, you will contribute to a broad range of meteorological frequency analyses and extreme storm analyses. Candidates should be able to demonstrate experience or exposure in several of the areas listed below (not all are required).

**Why Join Us?**

* Work on impactful domestic and international water resources projects.
* Apply state-of-the-art computational tools to complex water management challenges.
* Help advance modeling technologies and analytical methods.
* Collaborate with leading experts in a supportive, multidisciplinary environment.
* This position can be either based in RTI’s U.S. office in Research Triangle Park, NC, or it can be fully remote. Teleworking is permitted within the United States only.

What You'll Do:

You will support project teams requiring meteorological expertise to support hydrologic hazards, flood forecasting, and other analyses. You will work daily using scripts, tools, and techniques to efficiently prepare and analyze meteorological data including addressing climate change impacts using GCM data. You will also support project management and grow project portfolios.

**Essential Duties:**

* Collaborate with the Hydromet team to implement and enhance RTI’s hydrometeorological analysis tools.
* Perform data processing, quality control, and automation using scripts and tools.
* Collect, process, quality control, and statistically analyze large datasets of meteorological information.
* Develop code to improve existing hydrometeorological analysis tools and link to other existing hydrologic modeling or forecasting tools.
* Contribute to precipitation frequency and probable maximum precipitation analyses in support of dam safety projects.
* Lead small projects or task orders of moderate complexity.
* Contribute to proposal development.
* Share work internally and externally through presentations and conference papers.
* Make informed decisions based on data, best practices, and team input.
* Support business development by identifying opportunities to expand or enhance existing projects and developing research ideas or white papers.

What You'll Need:

**Minimum Education & Experience:**

Bachelor’s degree [DM1] and 8 years of relevant experience, master’s degree and 6 years of relevant experience, or a PhD and 1 year of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Relevant fields include Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, Hydrology, Climate Studies, or a related discipline.

**Minimum Required Qualifications:**

* Experience in the following areas:
  + Statistical analysis of hydrometeorological time series, precipitation frequency, and probable maximum precipitation.
  + Collection, QA/QC, and interpretation of hydrometeorological data.
  + Technical documentation and report writing.
  + Experience working with meteorological GIS datasets.
  + Proficiency with open-source programming languages (Python, R, C#, VB.NET) for data management, transformation, QC, and statistical analysis.
  + Basic geospatial processing and mapping using ArcGIS or QGIS.
  + Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and familiarity with relational databases (SQL).
* To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B visa status, etc.).

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with GCM datasets.
* Experience with extreme storm analyses.
* Familiarity with probabilistic or stochastic modeling concepts.

#LI-KV1

EEO & Pay Equity Statements:

For San Francisco, CA USA Job Postings Only: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Further information is available here.

RTI accepts applications to our job openings from candidates with criminal histories or conviction records in accordance with all applicable laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

For Applicants in Massachusetts Only: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

The anticipated pay range for this role is listed below. Our pay ranges represent national averages and may vary by location as a geographic differential may be applied to some location
